Bill.BriefDescription: Informing electric customers of the carbon dioxide emissions associated with the customer's electricity consumption.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to informing electric customers of the carbondioxide emissions associated with their electricity consumption; andadding a new section to chapter 19.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A retail supplier shall disclose in the customer billing for eachretail electric customer the estimated carbon dioxide emissionsassociated with the retail electric customer's electricity consumption.This estimate may be based on the retail supplier's fuel mix for theelectricity product provided.
